secret_key_comment.description: Free-form comment added to the key files during generation (-c)

public_key_path.description: Path to the public key file (-p)

secret_key_path.description: Path to the secret key file (-s)

message_file.description: Path to the message file to sign or verify (-m)

signature_file.description: Path to the signature file (-x). If empty, defaults to message.sig

key_type.description: Key type string for verification (-t). Empty for auto-detection.

embed_message.description: Enable -e flag to embed or extract message with signature

no_passphrase.description: Enable -n flag to skip passphrase prompt during key generation

use_gzip.description: Enable -z flag for gzip archive support
